nsa-cia-station-mexico-jfk:
The National Security Archive published this briefing book in 2026 from newly released records on the Kennedy assassination. Its subject is the CIA's Mexico City station, one of the largest in the world in 1963. The files are declassified United States government records on Lee Harvey Oswald's travels.

Oswald visited Mexico City weeks before the assassination, calling at the Soviet and Cuban embassies. The station photographed and wiretapped those embassies, and the briefing asks what it caught, what it passed to Washington, and what it held back. Decades of releases have not closed the argument. This set presents the last secrets the station's files still hold.
podcast-dannyjones-5cKiy3Pqsfk:
A Navy pilot brings new claims about the lost flight MH370 to the Danny Jones podcast. The Malaysia Airlines plane vanished in 2014 with 239 people aboard, and the search became the costliest in aviation history. This episode adds fresh evidence talk to the enduring mystery.

The pilot walks through the new material and what it may say about the plane's final hours. Nuclear war fears and so-called zombie flights, planes flying on with no one in control, widen the talk. Jones asks what governments may know and not say. Haunted listeners get another chilling pass over a case that refuses to close.
